scenario_description:
Objective: Use a short licensed-asset release to improve the visual clarity of the adaptive-release portfolio diagram before weekend polishing.
Emerging Need: An add-on is only a rumor until the release becomes a verified, affordable personal license with a SKU, discount, and same-day closing time.
Decision Context: Saved portfolio notes identify the exact pack as useful only under license, price, download, and attribution constraints; live calendar, wallet, and directory evidence determine feasibility.
Consequence: Capturing it could make the artifact easier to explain and reuse, while letting the pool close leaves requirements, scores, and ordinary portfolio work unchanged.
